About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 

About the Role

Fivetran's mission is to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity — with dbt Labs now part of Fivetran, that mission extends from moving data into the warehouse to transforming and modeling it for trusted, governed analytics.

We're looking for a Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. In this role, you'll work closely with Sales to understand Enterprise customers' complex data requirements — spanning ingestion, transformation, and data modeling — and demonstrate how the combined Fivetran + dbt platform helps them build reliable, end-to-end data pipelines. You'll own technical evaluations across the full data lifecycle: from replicating data into the warehouse to transforming it into governed, analytics-ready models with dbt Cloud.

 

Technologies You'll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Kafka, Grafana, Linux, Windows, Python, Java, Iceberg, dbt Cloud, SQL, data catalogs

 

What You'll Do

- Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, use cases, and requirements across data replication, transformation, and modeling

- Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences on the full Fivetran + dbt value proposition

- Ensure the technical win by running a tight proof-of-value process spanning ingestion through transformation

- Guide customers through dbt Cloud proof-of-concept implementations, including private-cloud deployments for enterprise clients where applicable

- Work closely with Product and Engineering to align solutions with Enterprise customer needs and inform the dbt Cloud enterprise roadmap

- Develop and maintain relationships with key Enterprise customers and partners (including Snowflake, AWS, Databricks)

- Own the technical relationship across the full customer lifecycle — pre-sale evaluation through adoption and expansion

- Stay current on trends in data movement, transformation, and analytics engineering; be an active participant in the dbt community

 

Skills We're Looking For

- 7+ years in data replication, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or consulting in data operations, analytics, or BI

- Strong technical background covering database replication, cloud infrastructure, and modern data warehousing architectures

- Hands-on experience with SQL, ETL/ELT, and data modeling

- Experience
